dimensions.assessment: Involves Federal, State, local, Tribal, and territorial officials requesting event security assessments.
Establishes standard processes for event ratings, security support, and mass gathering research.
No specific appropriations or dollar amounts are mentioned in the source bill text.
Amends the Homeland Security Act of 2002 to add a new section for a special events program.
Permanent authorization of the special events program and ongoing reporting requirements.

importance_detail.rationale: Provides statutory authority for DHS to assess threats and provide security support for pre-planned special events not designated as National Special Security Events.
